# SelfEvolvingMAS

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A multi-agent system that autonomously modifies its own structure, including agent roles and inter-agent connections, to improve long-term performance. Provides a framework for decentralized, topology-aware adaptation that can be mapped onto reconfigurable network substrates in TCC/iNEST.
